title: Eleven Minutes at a Railway Station
subtitle: 戏剧表演 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）
meta: 主题语境：戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）　|　核心词汇：scene　|　正文 296 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 scene 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The play had eleven ① scenes and one interval, and my mother, who had never acted, was given the ② scene in which a woman says goodbye at a railway station. She rehearsed it for eleven weeks and forgot every word on the night; the scene, as written, was four minutes long, and as played it was eleven.

What she did instead was stand still and ③ set the scene in her own words — the platform, the clock, the rain on a coat — and describe the ④ scene as if she were watching it, which she was, and which is the only piece of acting I have ever believed.

There were eleven of us ⑤ behind the scenes that night, none of us breathing, and my father, who had come ⑥ on the scene late and did not know the play, asked afterwards why everybody was crying. My mother said it was because the woman did not go.

The hall was pulled down in 1998 and the ⑦ scene of that evening — the building itself — is now a car park with nothing whatever to see. There is a ⑧ scene in the fourth act, cut in rehearsal, in which the woman looks back at the station from the train, and my mother said it was the most beautiful thing in the script and the reason she had agreed to do it.

She died in 2011 at eighty-one. She had never ⑨ made a scene in her life, on a stage or off one, and I think that is why the eleven minutes worked. The ⑩ scene I carry with me is not the play at all: it is eleven people in the wings, not breathing, watching a woman describe a railway station she had invented, and the scene going on without her.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 场景；场面；景象
B. n. （戏剧、电影的）一场；一个场景
C. n. （事件发生的）现场；地点
D. n. 景色；风景；画面
E. 固定搭配：on the scene 到场；在现场
F. 固定搭配：behind the scenes 幕后；在后台
G. 固定搭配：set the scene 布置场景；交代背景
H. 固定搭配：make a scene 当众大闹；出洋相

items.q: was given the scene in which a woman says goodbye
stand still and set the scene in her own words
describe the scene as if she were watching it
eleven of us behind the scenes that night
my father, who had come on the scene late
There is a scene in the fourth act
She had never made a scene in her life
The scene I carry with me

answers.why: scenes 意为“（戏剧的）场”，那出戏有十一场和一次幕间休息。
the scene in which ... 意为“……的那一场”，她分到的是火车站告别那一场。
set the scene 意为“交代场景、布置背景”，她站着不动，用自己的话把场景讲了出来。
the scene 意为“场面、景象”，她像在看着那个场面一样去描述它。
behind the scenes 意为“在幕后、在后台”，那天晚上我们十一个人在后台。
on the scene 意为“到场、在现场”，我父亲到得晚，不了解这出戏。
the scene of ... 意为“……的现场／发生地”，此处指那晚演出的那座建筑。
a scene 意为“画面、景象”，第四幕里那个从火车上回望车站的画面最美。
make a scene 意为“当众大闹、出洋相”，她这辈子台上台下都没有过。
the scene I carry 意为“我记着的那幅场面”，指后台十一个人看着她的那一幕。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 那出戏有十一场和一次幕间休息。（scenes）
她分到的是一位女子在火车站告别的那一场。（scene）
她站着不动，用自己的话把场景交代了出来。（set the scene）
那天晚上我们十一个人在后台，没有一个敢出声。（behind the scenes）
我父亲到得晚，不了解这出戏。（on the scene）
她这辈子从没当众大闹过，台上台下都没有。（make a scene）
